start.text: The Mercy puts in under the pines. Last down the plank, a bag over his shoulder and both hands on the rope, comes Brother Aldous.
start.note: Day 99: Aldous crosses after Thornwold's homecoming was already seen (arrival event thornwold_aldous_ashore).

start.text: He stands on the jetty and looks up past the pines at the ridge, a long time. Bram comes down to see who it is.
Door-warden. Was. ...Is there a ladder up to that?
Then I'll go up it. There's somebody up there I owe a thing to, in person. He said so himself.
He goes up the cart road toward the gap in the brambles, slowly, and doesn't look back.
